title: Maximum Array Hopping Score II
summary: Determine the highest score achievable by sequentially jumping from the initial index to any subsequent index in an array, where the score for each jump is calculated as the product of the jump distance and the value at the destination index.
statement: Determine the highest score achievable by sequentially jumping from the initial index to any subsequent index in an array, where the score for each jump is calculated as the product of the jump distance and the value at the destination index.
constraints: nums contains at least two positive integers and may be large.
Start at index zero and make rightward hops ending at the final index; hop i→j earns (j-i)*nums[j].
Return the maximum score in linear time.
reference_solution:
def maximum_array_hopping_score_fast(nums):
    best=answer=0
    for index in range(len(nums)-1,0,-1):best=max(best,nums[index]);answer+=best
    return answer

hints: A hop contributes its destination value once per unit gap crossed.
Assign each gap the maximum value to its right; suffix maxima produce a realizable sequence of hop endpoints.
Scan right to left, maintaining maximum destination value and adding it for each gap.
Choosing a new hop whenever the suffix maximum changes realizes all optimal gap assignments simultaneously.
